title: Silver Rewards Card: Software and SaaS Spending - Qualifying Categories
summary: Explains which merchant categories qualify for the Silver Rewards Card to earn 4.0% back on software/SaaS transactions, including productivity, cloud, developer/CI/CD, cybersecurity/identity, and design/analytics/CRM/ERP/accounting subscriptions. It also lists non-qualifying cases (hardware/peripherals, telecom/internet/hosting under telecom categories, app store gift cards, prepaid stored-value products) and tips to get transactions properly categorized or request a category review.
faqs: What merchant categories count as software or SaaS to earn 4.0% back on the Silver Rewards Card?
Which types of tech purchases do not qualify as software/SaaS (e.g., hardware, peripherals, or equipment)?
Do telecom, internet service provider, or hosting charges qualify for software/SaaS rewards?
Do app store gift cards or prepaid stored-value products qualify for the software/SaaS category?
How can I ensure my subscription transaction is categorized correctly as software/SaaS?
If my software/SaaS charge is miscategorized, what should I do? (category review)
keywords: App store gift cards & prepaid stored-value products
